text.en: We feel happy at different times for different reasons: when we play our favourite games, when we eat tasty food, when we are with friends. This chapter follows a grain of rice or wheat on its long journey from the farm to your plate, and then looks at four things that keep us happy and healthy: eating right, playing, sleeping well and feeling safe. At the end you will plan your own healthy day.

We enjoy foods made from grains, pulses and vegetables, and each food item reaches us after a journey. A grain of rice or wheat travels from the farm to our plate through many steps, and many people and animals make that journey possible. Farmers sow the seed, look after the crop and harvest it, and cattle help in the fields. Sellers and shopkeepers bring the grain to us, and family members cook it. Soil, water, air and sunlight are also needed for the grain to grow, and earthworms and insects help the soil. From the time a seed is sown till the food reaches our plate, the journey is a remarkable one that takes a lot of hard work.
When we remember everyone who helped bring food to our plate, with love and gratitude, we feel the value of each grain. You can think about whom you would like to thank for the food you eat, such as farmers, cattle, shopkeepers and the family cook. In India, many festivals show gratitude to Mother Nature for food, such as Makar Sankranti, Akshay Tritiya, Raja Utsav, Onam and Lohri.
The teacher asked the children to sit in a circle with their eyes closed and gave each a peanut. They followed instructions: put the food in your mouth slowly, feel its surface with your tongue, and chew it gently. They felt the flavour with the tongue, nose and other senses, and remembered the taste and the texture before swallowing. The tongue tastes and moves the food, the teeth chew it, and the food gets mixed with saliva in the mouth. Mindful eating means paying attention to what we eat and how we feel while eating, so we enjoy food more and make healthier choices.
Every grain is precious, and when we waste food we fail to respect the efforts of everyone who helped bring it to us. You can keep a record for a week of whether you finished your breakfast, lunch and dinner and how you felt. If someone offers you more food than you need, politely say that you have had enough, and if you do not like something, try a little or leave a small portion without wasting.
Along with good food we need regular physical activity to stay healthy, like playing in open fields with friends, running, jumping, cycling and skipping. These activities keep us strong and energetic, and we usually feel happy and fresh after a day of play. Yoga improves our posture and keeps us happy and active, and you can practise easy yoga poses for a week with your teacher's guidance. The textbook Khel Yoga has many interesting exercises and games.
After a day of play or exercise, the body needs rest, and good sleep takes away our tiredness and makes us feel fresh. When we do not get enough sleep it is hard to focus on work or play, and we feel tired, sleepy and irritable. So enough sleep is as important as healthy food and exercise. You can note when you slept, when you woke up and how you felt, to see how sleep affects your day.
Sometimes someone may feel unhappy, unsafe or uncomfortable. A safe touch, like a comforting hug from your mother or another family member, makes you feel happy and comfortable. An unsafe touch makes you feel uneasy, scared, confused or uncomfortable, whether it is from someone you know or a stranger. If anyone makes you feel uncomfortable, it is okay to say No clearly and to tell a trusted adult like your teacher or parents. You do not have to feel guilty, and you should always speak up if you feel unsafe. To stay happy and healthy, eat right, exercise, rest and keep both your body and mind safe and cared for.

altText.en: Four boxes: eat right, play and exercise, sleep well, feel safe.

problem.en: If soil, water or sunlight were missing, what would happen to a grain?

text.en: A seed needs soil to grow in and water to drink.
Plants make their food using sunlight.

why.en: Without sunlight the plant would stay weak and give no grain.

text.en: So all three are needed for the grain to reach our plate.

why.en: Nature plays a big part in our food.

problem.en: Plan a healthy day with the four habits.

text.en: Eat breakfast, lunch and dinner on time, with a balanced plate and no waste.
Play or do yoga for some time every day.
Go to bed on time and sleep peacefully.
Remember: if anything makes you feel unsafe, say No and tell a trusted adult.

prompt.en: Explain what mindful eating is and why it is good for us.

requiredIdeas.en: Pay attention to what we eat and how we feel
Eat slowly, feel the texture and flavour, chew well
Enjoy food more and make healthier choices

commonMisconceptions.en: Watching a screen while eating is mindful

points.en: A grain's journey from farm to plate involves soil, water, sunlight, farmers, cattle, sellers and family.
We should thank everyone who brings us food and never waste food.
Mindful eating means eating slowly and paying attention.
We need play, exercise, yoga and enough sleep to stay healthy.
Know safe and unsafe touch; say No and tell a trusted adult if you feel unsafe.
